title: Two Halves are More than One: Phase-wise Velocity Distillation for Fast and High-Quality Image Generation
abstract: Recent diffusion-based image generation backbones have grown substantially in scale, making the network inference cost increase rapidly. While diffusion distillation techniques can reduce the number of inference steps, high-quality image generation within a single full-backbone-forward compute budget remains challenging. Existing one-step methods typically allocate this budget to a single evaluation of a monolithic student. However, approximating the heterogeneous coarse-to-fine transport with a single monolithic mapping is difficult and often leads to over-smoothed outputs. To address this issue, we propose Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD), which partitions the generation timeline into a coarse and a fine phase, and models the transition within each phase via the average velocity. A dedicated half-sized expert is assigned to each phase, decoupling structural composition from detail refinement while keeping the cumulative computation equivalent to one full-backbone forward pass. We show that the use of two half-sized phase-specific experts outperforms a single full-size monolithic student. On class-conditional image generation, PVD achieves an FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256 x 256. On more complex text-to-image (T2I) tasks, PVD-distilled models (Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image) produce results competitive with their multi-step teachers, significantly outperforming prior distillation methods. Moreover, across the evaluated T2I backbones, PVD reduces active parameters by 49.10-50.89% and peak VRAM by 45.76-48.36% compared to the corresponding teachers. Source code and distilled models are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/PVD.

analysis.ideaZh: PVD 把noise-to-image拆为两次half-depth expert transport，以局部MeanFlow速度目标+T2IphaseGAN减轻一整model单jump过平滑。作者报告ImageNetFID1.48、QwenGenEval.8846，在约一full-forward FLOPs下保较强quality；实际两networkcalls，VRAM只backbone，Qwen额外NFT、early复用两次GenEval.6754接近full.6948，不能把全部gain归严格coarse/fine角色。
analysis.motivationZh: 将长 diffusion/flow 轨迹压成很少的生成步骤，会要求模型一次跨越困难的 noise-to-image 映射，容易损失细节或出现过平滑。论文关注有限计算预算下的图像质量，而不只减少采样步骤的数字。
analysis.methodZh: 保teacher前后各3blocks并均匀抽intermediate到半depth，先teacherinstantaneousFM对齐。time[0,.4]/[.4,1]独立专家追加intervaltimeembedding，SD/fullC2I为两fullytrained模型、FLUX/Qwen shared半backbone+两LoRA。MeanFlowidentity用JVP alongteachervelocity构stopgradselfconsistentaveragetarget，T2Iteacherfeaturephase-specifichingediscriminator并行refine；最终earlyendpoint输入late。完整33页正文、数学、trainingdatasets/NFT、categoryresults、cost、ablation和failure已读。
methodFlow: 推理先early[0,.4]一次transport再late[.4,1]一次，LoRA共享base且两phase权重切换。

analysis.insightZh: 新意是把累计onefullbackboneFLOPs分配到orderedhalf-depthphaseexperts，结合localmeanobjective及modelcompression。Timeexpert/MeanFlow/GAN已有；两个定理是samepathintegralerror与boundedvelocitymarginalshift基础界，只motivateshortphase，不证明halfcapacity足够或必优单体。
analysis.evidenceZh: onefull-forward是normalized累计FLOPs，实际两halfnetworkcalls且phaseweights分离。（Fig.3/Sec.3.1-3.4, PDF pp.4-6; Algorithms1-2, p.19）；Qwen比较有额外NFTbackboneposttraining，qualitygain不完全isolatesphasearchitecture。（Appendix D/Table6, PDF p.20）；GAN与phase都提升，但earlyreuse很接近指定order。（Appendix I/Tables16-17, PDF pp.30-31）；memory/latency只backbone测量，不代表整pipeline精确减半。（Appendix G/Table14, PDF p.26）
analysis.caveatZh: Sec.5 p.10number/partition经验选择未优化，densecount/uncommonspatialrelations仍失败。；Appendix J p.32 35macaron输出36、pencil穿mugwall非handle；teacher也失败。；Unsplashfurthertraining降低GenEval，aesthetic与preciseconstraints折衷。；训练两phase在data-interpolatedstates，后phase部署在early-generatedendpoint，exposuremismatch尚未isolated。；globalbounduniformC/L对实际unboundedGaussianprior/neuralfield未验证，theorems不保证最优halfdepth。；NFT/data/GAN及capacity配置混合，phase优越性不可从alltableheadline单归因。；onlybackbonecost、PPUhardware具体型号不清，latency与batch/weightoffloading部署细节需复现。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: imagegeneratorcapacity/timefactorization直接改善fewstepvisualcreation，提供半backbone+phaseconditioning方法；不是普通serving减少dtype，highdeep。
